name: Manu Bhaskaran
detail: Economist who analyzed wealth taxes but emphasized risks of capital flight and middle-class collateral damage; did not endorse an actual wealth tax

name: Tommy Koh
detail: Speaks frequently and passionately against economic inequality and for a fairer society, but has not advocated an actual net wealth tax

name: Singapore Democratic Party
detail: Policy platform calls for reinstating estate duties, luxury taxes, and raising top-1% income taxes, which fall outside the definition of an actual net wealth tax
